generation.method: projectStartup(configuration, { uncertain: true, replication }) once for every declared phase, profile and replication; summarizeStartupTrials recomputed from persisted JSONL before publishing.
generation.compression: node:zlib gzipSync, level 9, zero timestamp; UTF-8 JSON Lines with LF and a final newline.
generation.recordKind: Per-trial startup-cohort financial summaries, not full transaction/event traces or operating-agent runs. The raw trial archive excludes monthly trajectories. Three nominal plans include monthly rows as separate artifacts, not additional sampled trials.
generation.sourceNormalization: Remove optional UTF-8 BOM; normalize CRLF and CR to LF before SHA-256.

seedScheme.generator: Counter-keyed xoshiro128** in simulation/math.mjs; deterministic pseudorandom draws, not a security generator.
seedScheme.comparison: Profiles within a phase reuse the same replication keys and seed (common random numbers). Profiles are paired assumptions, not independent observations. Holdout uses a separate seed, not new human or market observations.

assumptions.growth: Symmetric triangular multiplier centered on 1 with width growthUncertainty.
assumptions.cost: Symmetric triangular multiplier centered on 1 with width costUncertainty, shared across modeled operating costs.
assumptions.churn: Symmetric triangular multiplier centered on 1 with width churnUncertainty.
assumptions.delay: launchDelay plus a discrete uniform integer from 0 through delayUncertainty, inclusive.
assumptions.capitalQuantiles: Linear interpolation of sorted integer USD cents at index (n - 1) * p; quantiles may be fractional cents.
assumptions.breakEven: First start of six consecutive months with nonnegative operating cash profit; target also requires nonnegative cash profit in the final six months.
assumptions.selection: Only member-value-first and balanced were carried from design into holdout. This is not validation of all ten profiles or an independently preregistered selection.
assumptions.limits: Synthetic, uncalibrated assumptions; not empirical success probabilities, independent human observations, a causal capital effect, or investment forecasts. Capital does not change the planned member ramp or spending. Equivalent service and no member-paid switching costs are assumed. Taxes, debt service and investor return requirements are excluded.

records.failurePolicy: Abort generation on any projection or serialization error; retain unfavorable outcomes and null break-even results. No imputation or silent exclusions.

recordSchema.seedReference: Base seed and counter key prefix; append growth, cost, churn or delay.
recordSchema.projectionId: Model identifier from config and factors, not a cryptographic provenance hash.
recordSchema.factors: Realized growth, cost and churn multipliers plus total delay in months.
recordSchema.summary: All projection summary financial outputs and Boolean outcome flags. Money is integer USD cents; months and member/staff counts are unscaled. Null month means not reached in the configured horizon.
recordSchema.flags: goalsMet is the conjunction defined in assumptions.goal.
